summary.text: T.J. Roberts is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 66 since 2025 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: T.J. Roberts was born in Edgewood, Kentucky.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Transylvania University in 2019 and a law degree from the Salmon P. Chase College of Law at Northern Kentucky University in 2023.
His career experience includes working as a lawyer, and he previously worked in the horse racing and restaurant industry.
Roberts assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Steve Rawlings (R).
In the 2025-2026 session he served on the Elections, Constitutional Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs, House Judiciary, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
